wp: WP3 - eps drift on the Yagci 180 Ah cycling cells
registered: 2026-10-16, after the qualification audit of file structure (column names, cycle ranges, cell labels) and before any eps value was computed

qualification.cells: 4 cycling cells: CA-181103-19 and -42 (35 C), -22 and -28 (50 C); storage cells excluded by design (no operating charge)
qualification.rpt: checkups after cycles 0, 100, 500, 1000 (paper: 20 C, 50 A CC-CV, second cycle); RPT capacity = max_CCCV_DIS of 'Capacities in checkups - all cells.xlsx' as in round 6 (sheet #1500 excluded: byte-identical copy of #1000)
qualification.operating_charge: 'Analysis individual cycles - cyclic aging cells.xlsx', column max_CCCV_CHA (charge Ah to CV end), cycle_no continuous 1..~1500; the first operating cycle after checkup k is cycle k+1
qualification.result: qualifies: 4 cells with 3 RPTs after the initial one (exit rule needs >= 2 cells with >= 3 RPTs)

estimand.eps_j: C_RPT,j - Q_ch,j for j in {0, 100, 500, 1000}, both scaled to 102 Ah by x 102/180 (scaling does not change the slope)
estimand.Q_ch_main: max_CCCV_CHA of cycle j+1 (the first operating charge after RPT j)
estimand.start_state_guard: if |Q_ch(cycle j+1) - median Q_ch(cycles j+2..j+4)| > 1 % of 180 Ah, the first cycle is flagged 'partial start' and that point uses the median of cycles j+2..j+4 in the main estimate; flags are reported
estimand.d_cell: OLS slope of eps_j on L_j over the 4 points; leave-one-checkup-out range (4 refits)
estimand.temperature: RPT at 20 C, cycling at 35 / 50 C: eps_0 is reported per temperature group; the slope is the target

pooling.values: LIC 280 Ah -0.035 and Gotion 53 Ah -0.031 (external_data/DATA_MANIFEST.md); Yagci 35 C group = mean of the 2 cells' d, Yagci 50 C group = mean of the 2 cells' d
pooling.report: median, range, leave-one-dataset-out median (4 datasets: LIC, Gotion, Yagci35, Yagci50)

recommendation_rule.recommend_minus_0p020: both Yagci group values within (-0.015, +0.01); state the disagreement
recommendation_rule.sign_not_robust: any Yagci group value > +0.01: flag 'drift sign not robust' and recommend probing P_drift after the other probes
recommendation_rule.mixed: any other combination (one group in [-0.05, -0.015], the other in (-0.015, +0.01], or a value < -0.05): recommend d = the pooled median clipped to [-0.035, -0.015] and state the disagreement

soh_tables: SUB + drift with the recommended d (real, delta 0.4, main), SOH per checkup; grid scores on the round-6 grid plus WP1's H_ov_after (b_0 = median) family
not_usable: TUM kxh42bfgtj (2018 calendar) and Mendeley 6hgyr25h8d (2020 cycle) carry no charge capacity; recorded, not used
